sharding.rule: shard i owns zero-based descriptor indices [i*1152,(i+1)*1152) exactly

compiler_independence: The descriptor-to-MFST compiler has no reference authority and must not import or call W7, W8, W5, W6, W9, G1 generator code, crossed-gate code, C2 code, or any RISU parser/executor/canonicalizer.
The compiler implements only the frozen descriptor_to_mfst_compilation_contract from RISU_KERNEL_K1_MFST_C3_REFERENCE_R0.json.
The compiler must not compute expected traces, expected K1 relations, target IDs, graph IDs, trace IDs, or preservation verdicts.
A compiler error is expected to manifest as a W9 mismatch even if W7 and W8 agree with each other.
per_descriptor_required_square: Regenerate the exact W9 corpus using the pinned W9 source and reject the whole run unless its aggregate SHA-256 equals c731db89e79e75f4d22f38788aded1a9c9e70572467615da448b7e1c9ce93346 before selecting any shard records.
Compile exactly one MFST profile from the frozen descriptor.
W7 direct accepts and its point->ordered-payload trace map equals W9 exactly.
W8 direct accepts and its point->ordered-payload trace map equals W9 exactly.
W7 direct trace map equals W8 direct trace map.
W7 and W8 generate byte-identical CBTNF-v1 and byte-identical C2 artifact JSON.
W8 replay of exact W7-generated CBTNF-v1 equals W9 exactly.
W7 replay of exact W8-generated CBTNF-v1 equals W9 exactly.
W7 and W8 project the same K1 REALIZE set.
W5 reconstruction from W7 producer path equals the direct K1 projection.
W6 reconstruction from W7 producer path equals the direct K1 projection.
W5 reconstruction from W8 producer path equals the direct K1 projection.
W6 reconstruction from W8 producer path equals the direct K1 projection.
No descriptor is skipped because two descriptors happen to be behaviorally equivalent.

campaign_integrity: Every shard summary binds its exact descriptor range, W9 root, compiler blob, frozen checker blobs, count, and deterministic digest.
Aggregate fails if any shard is missing, overlaps, has a gap, reports a different W9 root, or has any nonzero mismatch counter.
The four common-mode veto controls are separate from the 18,432 valid descriptor count.
The original F0 62-oracle gate and G1 4,288-scenario gate remain scientifically separate; R0 supplements rather than replaces them.
promotion_effect: A green R0 cross gate provides an orthogonal exhaustive finite-reference result against common-mode W7/W8 semantic error in the exact R0 sublanguage. It still does not create a production proof kind or C3 preservation authority.
nonclaims: R0 does not prove correctness of W7/W8 outside the frozen sublanguage.
R0 does not cover loops, multiple state cells, multiple user inputs, larger domains, unbounded execution, concurrency, nondeterminism, ambient capabilities, native code, or remote attestation.
R0 does not prove absence of all implementation bugs.
The descriptor compiler itself remains non-authoritative; agreement with the frozen W9 reference is what validates its behavior over the exhaustive R0 population.
